$Comment: What a player sees and hears when their rank with a reputation rises during play: a reward, a kill or
a piece of gear lifted their standing (earned plus what their gear adds) into a higher rank. It never
fires for a fall, nor at login: the first look after login only notes where the player stands.
This is the library's own neutral default. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its own pack
replaces it (a pack that lists this library as a dependency loads after it), and a server owner can do
the same. Override the whole file rather than editing this one.
The moment carries 'rank' (the rank's name as that reputation calls it, in the reader's language),
'name' (the reputation's name) and the reputation id under 'source'; 'player' is always who rose.
Key is a line from a .lang file and Args names which of those values fill its blanks, in order. Sound
is any SoundEvent id, played at the player's own position.
